tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (tha)༄༅/ /rgyud sde bzhi'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge spyi 'gro dngos grub rin po che'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti/gang la bas
(tha)༄༅/ /rgyud sde bzhi'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge spyi 'gro dngos grub rin po che'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti/gang la bas

tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// rgyud sde bzhi'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge spyi 'gro dngos grub rin po che'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ gang la bsten na mchog dang thun mong gi// dngos grub ma lus 'bad med stsol mdzad pa// zhi dang khro sogs sna tshogs skur ston pa'i// yi dam lha tshogs rnams la gus btud nas// rgyud sde bzhi 'brel yi dam lha tshogs kyi// bsnyen pa'i rim pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul// rgyud sde so so'i dgongs pa ji bzhin du// ma 'dres go bde'i ngag gis 'dir bshad bya// de la 'dir rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bsnyen pa bya tshul la sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ dmigs bsal yod na ma gtogs thams cad 'dra bas/ gnas khang yid du 'ong ba/ bla ma gong ma'i zhabs kyis bcags pa'am/ min kyang bkod mdzes phyi nang gis dgra med cing steng 'og bar gsum thams cad mtshams ma grol bar rang dbang du 'du nges pa dgos shing*/ der sa rgyan gnam rgyan sogs bkod mdzes su bsham/ kha phyogs kyang zhi ba la shar/ rgyas par byang*/ dbang la nub/ drag po la lho ngos rnams su rnal 'byor pa'i kha blta zhing*/ dmigs bsal dpal mchog dang rnam sras sogs la byang kho nar lta/ de mthun yi dam gang byed kyi bris 'bur gyi rten dang*/ gzhan yang bris 'bur gyi rten 'byor pa dang bstun pa dang gtor ma sogs kyang rang gi kha phyogs dang mthun par bya zhing*/ bsham tshul ni rang gi 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i stegs bang rim can la rten khebs sogs bkab pa'i steng du yi dam gang byed kyi gtor ma so so'i gzhung las byung ba ltar rgyan spros 'byor pa gang che dang*/ rgyun du chag med byed bzhin pa yin na de'i gtor ma/ de dag gi mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod sogs so so'i gzhung ltar bsham/ thams cad mthun par stan gyi 'og tu rdo rje rgya gram gyi steng du 'bras gro nas 'bru sogs gtor/

de steng shing khri lta bu la khrol tshags byas pa'am/ ma 'byor na spen ma lta bu bting bas stan mi rul ba'i khyad yong*/ stan ni zhi ba la dkar po/ rgyas pa la ser po/ dbang la dmar po/ drag po la gcan gzan gdug pa can gyi pags pa sogs bting*/ ma 'byor na gang lcogs byas kyang 'gal ba tsam med/ dus ni zla ba gang yang rung ba'i mar ngo'i gza' tshes bzang ba bla ma gong ma'i dus chen dang 'dzoms na rab/ ma 'dzoms kyang gza' tshes bzang po'i phyi dro/ thun gyi grangs ni rgyud las/ thun gsum du byin brlabs pa'i sgom pa rnam par bsgoms nas zhes thun gsum mam/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pas lam gyi thun bzhi la dbang bzhi bsgoms pas lus la brten nas bde chen gyi sgrib pa dag cing*/ zhes gsungs pas thun bzhi gsum gang rung bya bar gsungs na'ang*/ thun bzhi ma nyid bde bas sgrub khang gi nyi ma ma nub gong du sgrub grogs 'ga' zhig dang bcas pa'am/ ma 'byor na rang gcig pus cha gsum yid ches pa zhig btang*/ bgegs gtor phyir dor ba dang dmigs pa bsnyen sgrub zab mo bgyid par bar chad byed pa'i bgegs thams cad phyir bskrad par bsam zhing*/ bla ma gong ma'i ljags gul ljags thun sogs kyis bdug cing brab/ de nas sgo'i phyi rol du rang dbang 'du nges pa'i sar tho brtan par btsugs la sa dkar gyis bran/ dar lcog btsugs par bskyed chog zur du yod pa ltar bya zhing me tog gtor ro// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ de nas stan gyi steng du 'dug la bdag gis bsnyen mtshams 'di ma grub bar du steng nas gnam rdib bam 'og nas sa g.yos kyang rung ste gang la yang rnam rtog gi dbang du ma song bar bya/ de yang lo zla tsam 'gor kyang dam bca' 'di las mi 'gal bar bya snyam du rbad khams bcad/ thog mar rang la sku drin che ba'i bla ma'i sku bstod/ khyad par yi dam gang byed de'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sogs yid la 'khul nges bya/

de nas yi dam gang byed de'i skyabs 'gro nas bzung*/ bzlas pa la thug gi bar so so'i mngon rtogs ltar bya zhing*/ de yang yi dam che ba'i rigs kyi bsnyen pa rgyun ring tsam byed na skyabs 'gro la'ang nyin gsum tsam dang*/ bla ma'i sku bstod la yang de mtshungs bya zhing*/ gang ltar yang tshugs pa'i nub mo sngags ring thung la dpags pa'i brgya stong gang 'gro byed/ de nas thun bsdus la yi dam gang yin de'i gtor 'bul dang*/ rgyun du chag med kyi rigs dang*/ gtor 'bul gang byed skabs 'dir bya zhing*/ bza' btung dgos na thun gyi sgang la ja phran bu tsam las gzhan bza' btung gtan nas bya mi rung*/ grub na mtshams ma grol bar ngag bcad byung na rab/ de ltar ma grub kyang thun tshugs nas ma grol bar du tha mal pa'i 'phros pa lta ci smos/ dgos gal che nges byung yang saṃ ṭa lta bur bris nas byed pa ma gtogs gtan nas mi rung*/ deng sang kha cig so bsgrigs nas gtam smra ba dang*/ kha'i phyed lag pas bkab nas 'phros gtam byed pa 'dug kyang spre'u'i rkun ma'i khyad chos lhur len pa de lta bu nam yang mi bya/ khyad par rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi dus thun gyi sgang la glal dang*/ sbrid pa dang*/ glo dgog pa dang*/ 'og rlung lta bu gang byung yang de 'phral kha bshal/ phreng skor gcig pu de grangs la mi rtsi ba sogs la bslab/ 'ga' zhig thun gyi sgang la chab seng dgos pa byung na mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi dpe bzhag nas phreng ba stan steng du bzhag nas 'gro ba sogs kyang rgyud sde gong mar yang bya mi rung na 'og mar lta ci smos pas chos la dbang za ba de lta bu nam yang mi bya/ chab seng dgos pa byung na zangs teg lta bur bya zhing rgyud sde 'og ma rnams la sngar bshad kyi phreng skor gcig mi rtsi ba sogs bya/ de lta bu'i rim pas sgrub khang gi nyi ma nub nas chag med kyi rigs yod na 'dir bya/

de nas srod 'khor bar rang nyid gnyid mi bro tshun la sngar ltar skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar dang*/ yi dam gang yin gyi gtor 'bul byas nas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor bshad pa rnams la de'i sgo nas nyal zhing*/ ma bshad pa rnams la rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par gnyid log de ltar dgong thun dang srod thun song nas/ tho rengs gnyis sad pa dang ldang ba'i rnal 'byor yod na de nyid dang*/ med na stong nyid kyi ngang du langs nas rgyud sde 'og ma gsum dang*/ khyad par bya spyod gnyis la khrus byas nas skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar sngags ring thung la dpags pa'i bzla lugs dang*/ de nas sgrub khang la nyi ma 'char khar thun bsdu ba sogs sngon ltar bya/ de nas gtor ma brgya rtsa sogs chag med kyi rigs kyang bya zhing tsha bzhes kyang bya/ de nas gung ma zin tshun thun bsdu ba'i bar sngar bzhin bya/ gung tshigs bar 'dir bya zhing*/ gung yol nas sgrub khang gi nyi ma nub khar thun bsdus/ gtor 'bul gyi rigs gzhan byed bzhin pa yin na'ang bar 'dir byas la chag med gzhan dgos rigs kyang 'dir bya ste/ mdor na thun sgang la 'phros pa dang cho ga rigs mi mthun gyi rigs gtan nas ma shor ba bya'o// de yang rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi bsnyen pa gang byed kyang legs grub las/ sha chang ke ru btsong dang sgog rdog dang*// 'bru mar til dang la phug su ra na// 'byung po'i zas dang lha bshos gtor ma dang*// gu lang mchod byas gtor ma mi za'o// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ 'bru mar dag gis lus mi bku// til yang bza' bar mi bya'o// la phug sgog pa tshwa dag dang*// chang skyur rnam pa tha dad dang*// cung seng dang ni sran ril dang*// de bzhin ma sha'i sran ma dang*// til gyi cung seng la du dag /dngos grub 'dod pas rnam par spang*// zhes dang*/ sbyong rgyud las kyang*/ chang ni btung bar mi bya zhing*// sha la sogs pa bza' mi bya// zhes gsungs pas rdor dkar kho nar bsten pa dang*/

dmigs bsal grwa lnga la sogs par bu ram yang zas ngan par bshad pas de skabs su spang*/ mtshams g.yog kyang rgyun tu gcig las mang bar mi bya zhing*/ thog ma nas 'dis ma lcogs na 'di bya snyam pa'i nyer bsdogs dang*/ lha rje yang dmigs khongs su tshud par bya zhing*/ sngags g.yog med par mi bya ste/ legs grub las/ sngags g.yog dag gi mtshan nyid bshad// rigs mthun chos spyod dad pa can// sems stobs che la rtsol phod pa// bden par smra zhing gus pa che// zhes sogs kyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gcig ni nges par dgos la/ slob dpon byang chub mchog gis kyang*/ rang gi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i sngags g.yog dang ldan pas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// spyir bsnyen pa la mtshan dus grangs te/ dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum du phye bas dgur gsungs pa ni rab dang*/ 'bring dus kyi bsnyen pa la zla ba'i grangs so so las bshad pa ltar dang*/ tha ma grangs kyi bsnyen pa ni spyir 'bum bzlas zhes gsungs pa'i don gsang sngags yi ge so gnyis yod pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ legs grub las/ mkhas pas gsang sngags yi ge ni// bco lnga man chad grangs rnams la// spyir ni yi ge du yod pa// de snyed 'bum phrag bzlas brjod bya// yi ge sum cu so gnyis la// bzlas brjod sum 'bum bya bar bshad// de bas yi ge mang po la// sngon du bsnyen pa khri bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar yi ge bco lnga man chad la 'bru 'bum dang*/ de yan chad la gsum 'bum/ yi ge shin tu mang po la khri bzla bar gsungs shing*/ rtsod ldan gyi dus su bzhi 'gyur bya bar gsungs pa ltar/ phal cher la de yin cing*/ so so'i grangs dang sgos chos sogs so so'i gzhung ltar bya'o// bgrang phreng ni brtag gnyis las/ shel gyis rengs pa'i bzlas pa nyid// dbang la tsan+dan dmar po dang*// lung thang gis ni mngon spyod nyid// ni raṃ shus ni sdang ba la// zhes sogs dang*/

sam+bu ṭir/ zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la// bo dhi tsis ni las kun byed// ces gsungs pas rgyud sde bzhi char la sbyar du rung*/ khyad par legs grub las/ rgyal ba'i rigs la bo dhi tsi// sngags kyi nor bu rab tu grags// pad+ma'i rigs la pad+ma'i snying*// rdo rje'i rigs la ru rak+ṣa// rigs gsum de dag thams cad la// nor bu de dag rab tu grags// zhes sogs dang*/ dpung bzang las kyang*/ bo dhi tsi dang dung shel ru rak+ṣa// lung thang pad+ma'i snying po zha nye bzang*// 'khar ba'i grangs ni brgya dang rtsa brgyad pa// zhes pa'i bgrang phreng brgya dang brgyad dam/ slob dpon byang chub mchog gis stong brgyad dam/ brgya brgyad dam/ lnga bcu bzhi'am/ nyi shu gcig blangs la zhes gsungs pa ltar 'du byas te/ legs grub las gsungs pa'i rigs so so'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlab pa'am/ yang na phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra war+dha ya swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i kha rlangs phreng bar phog par bya zhing*/ bla med kyi skabs phreng ba byin rlabs sogs so so'i skabs su shes par bya zhing*/ spyi khyab tu 'di kho nas don 'grub/ bgrang ba'i tshul ni legs grub las// nor bu snying gar bzung nas su// bzlas brjod rab tu brtsam par bya// zhes dang*/ dpung bzang las/ de dag las ni bgrang phreng gcig blangs te// de ni lag pa g.yas kyis bzung pa'am// lag pa g.yon pas bsgrims te mi 'khrul bzung*// tshar re phyin cing nor bu re re las// sngags pa yis ni rim bzhin bgrang bar bya// zhes gsungs shing*/ yang legs grub las/ mthe bong dang ni srin lag gis// las rnams kun la nor bu dang*// mkhas pas drag po'i las rnams la// mdzub mos bgrang bar bya ba nyid// ces pas bgrang phreng bzung zhing*/ bya rgyud rang rkang gi bsnyen pa'i skabs lag pa g.yas g.yon gang la bgrang phreng yod pa des rdo rje nges par bzung ba bya rgyud spyi'i lugs so// bzlas pa'i dus dmigs bsal bshad pa ma gtogs spyi khyab thams cad la/

slob dpon byang chub mchog gis/ rang gi snying ga na gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor dang lha'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rang gi sngags bzla bar bya'o// gsang sngags kyi yi ge rim pa bzhin du bkod nas/ mngon sum dang 'dra bar bltas te/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdun gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ la sogs pa'i lha so so'i sa bon dang*/ mtha' skor du rang rang gi sngags kyi phreng bas g.yas phyogs su bskor ba mgo gyen du lta bar bsam/ rang gi snying gar sngar bsgoms pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge rnams lha dang 'dra bar bkod la/ sngags phreng rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas mchod pa dang*/ sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus yi ge rnams la thim par bsam/ dpung bzang las kyang*/ bzlas brjod byed tshe mi myur mi dal zhing*// sgra chen mi dbyung ha cang chung ba'ang min// gug skyed klad kor tsheg drag nyams pa min// zhes gsungs pa ltar sngags kyi ring cha thung cha ma thon pa'am lhag pa gug skyed lhag chad du gyur pa ni shin tu mi rung ste/ dpung bzang las/ cho ga nyams shing yi ge gug skyed med// mchod pa med cing mi gtsang bzlas brjod byas// gug skyed yi ge chad lhag gyur pa yis// gsang sngags dngos grub rgya cher mi ster ro// zhes gsungs pas sngags dag par 'don pa shin tu gal che'o// 'di rnams gtso bo bya rgyud shas che ba'i dbang du byas kyang rgyud sde gong ma rnams la yang dmigs bsal ma gtogs 'dra bas/ gcig shes kun grol rgya 'bag gi mig ltar 'phrul shes par bya'o// bya spyod rang rkang gi bsnyen pa byed pa'i dus bzlas pa zin ma thag 'bul ba bya dgos pas bzlas pa zin ma thag lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi srin lag gi rgyab tu so so'i gung mo bzhag g.yas g.yon gyi mdzub mo gnyis kyis so so'i gung srin mnan nas dkris/
mthe'u chung gshibs te bsgrengs/ mthe bong gnyis mdzub mo'i tshigs dbus mar bzhag pa bum pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ bdag gis dge

dmigs bsal yod na 'di zhes bya ba/ ba'i rtsa ba 'di mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa'i rgyur bcom ldan 'das la 'bul lo// mgon po khyod kyis bdag la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes 'bul dgos te/ dpung bzang las/ nyin gcig bzhin du byas nas bzlas pa ni// phul nas cho ga bzhin du gshegs su gsol// zhes gsungs pas/ bya spyod 'di rnams spyod pa shin tu dog pas/ phyi nyan thos 'dul ba'i spyod pa dang mi 'gal ba'i sgo nas sgrub khang gi phyi rol du khrus bya ba/ nang du chas su zhugs pa sogs shin tu rung ba dges shing de dag gi bya tshul sogs bya rgyud spyi rnam dang mkhas pa'i ngag rgyun las zhib par shes dgos pas rigs gsum spyi/ gzungs grwa lnga/ gdugs dkar/ dri med rnam gnyis/ rnam rgyal sogs bsnyen pa'i dus deng sang gi bar du phyag len ma nyams par yod pas mtshams byas lo tsam gyi sla chos su ma song ba gal che'o// zhes lag len pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so// rgyud sde gong mar gti thug gi rigs 'gre yang mi dgos/ gong 'og 'dra bar thun mtshams thams cad du rten la phyag dang bskor ba la sogs pa bya dgos te/ dpung bzang las/ bzlas pas skyon mdo sde bklag par bya// zhes dang*/ legs grub las/ shes rab pha rol phyin sogs kyi// glegs bam mjug tu bklag pa dang*// mchod rten dag dang dkyil 'khor yang*// dus gsum dag tu de bzhin bya// zhes gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor ni maṇ+ḍal yin pas thun mtshams su bsod nams 'phel ba'i phyir dkon mchog mchod pa dang*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sogs dang*/ shes shing nus na bya spyod kyi skabs su mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi skabs de bzhin nyid/ bla med la rdzogs rim sogs kyang bsgom rgyu byung na phan yon shin tu che zhing*/ so so'i bsnyen pa gang yang thog mar dal ba/

bar du grims pa/ tha mar lhod pa bsnyen pa nas 'dra bar bya gsungs// ༈ /rnal 'byor bla med spyi'i bsnyen thabs kun mkhyen go rams pas mdzad pa'i bsnyen bsgrub bdud rtsi bum bzang ni/ oṃ swa sti/ bla ma lhag pa'i lhar bcas la// sgo gsum gus pa'i spyi bos 'dud// rgyud sde rnam pa bzhi po las// mchog dang thun mong sgrub pa'i thabs// bsnyen sgrub las gsum cho ga gsungs// de yi dang po bsnyen pa la// rab 'bring tha gsum rnam dbye mang*// 'dir ni grangs kyi bsnyen pa yi// byed thabs cung zad bri bar bya// de la'ang rab 'bring tha gsum yod// phyi ma gnyis ni 'dir mi gtogs// rab la sbyor dngos rjes gsum mo// dang po ni/ gnas khang dben zhing yid du 'ong ba bkra shis pa'i nang du phyag dar skyang nul legs par byas/ rten mchod rnam par dag pa yang bsham/ de nas bad kan dang tsha ba shas che ba'i gang zag yin na/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor rang rang gi sgrub thabs nas bshad pa bzhin du bya/ rlung dang grang ba shas che na ma byas pas 'ong ste/ bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gro na khrus kyi rnal 'byor bya zhes gsungs pa'i don yin no// khrus ma byas kyang thun mtshams su zas za ba dang*/ rtswa chu 'chag pa na'ang chab legs po len dgos te/ grub chen nā ro ta pa'i gsung gis/ kha mi bshal bar sngags zlos spang*// zhes gsungs so// de nas stan nang tshangs can la 'jig rten pa'i shar du kha phyogs pas skyil krung gnyis po gang rung ngam/ tsog krung du 'dug pa dang*/ thog mar rang gi blo la brtag dpyad legs por bya dgos te/ rje bla ma'i gsung gis/ gya tshom du mi 'jug gsungs pa'i don/ rang gi sems nyon mongs pa dang*/ rnam rtog gzhan gyi dbang du 'dug na/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa la sogs pas blo legs par bcos nas dge ba la bskul dgos kyi/ de ltar ma byas na nyams len nyon mongs kyi dbang du 'gro bas/ dge ba mi 'grub pas/

bla ma dang dkon mchog la dad pa'i kun slong brtan pos sems dge ba la bskul nas dran shes kyis yang dang yang du sems nyon mongs pa dang ma 'dres pa ci thub byed pa gal che ste/ nā ro ta pas/ dad pa med pa'i le lo spang*// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams te/ ma rgyud dang pha rgyud so so'i lugs kyi rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyis rgyud dag par byed cing*/ de nas mngon par rtogs pa sbyong gzhi dang sbyong byed ngo sprad pa'i rim pas/ dmigs pa gsal rung mi gsal rung*/ rnam rtog gzhan gyi dbang du ma song bar sems 'jur mig nas drangs la shar re shar 'don gyi tshul du 'gro ba ni/ bir+wa pa yab sras kyi man ngag las/ gsal la drag la yun thung ba// bskyed pa'i rim la gnad du che// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de nas rang rang gi bskyed rim la sems 'dzin pa'i skabs su sleb pa dang*/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i don spyi thams cad dang*/ lhag par du yang rang nyid gtso bo de'i zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs bzhugs stangs dang bcas pa snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la nga rgyal yun ring po'i bar du 'dzin/ las dang po pas dmigs pa gsal po med kyang lha de yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal brtan po la yun ring du mnyam par bzhag pa la phan yon che ste/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur las/ sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis// sangs rgyas nyid du nges par 'grub// 'grub rgyu'i sangs rgyas ni/ ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan// gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cur ldan// zhes gsungs so// de nas phreng ba byin rlabs dang bcas pas/ rang rang gi gzhung nas bshad pa'i zhi rgyas dbang drag gi dmigs pa la nan tan bskyed cing*/ sngags lhag chad med par dag por bzla dgos te/ nā ro ta pas/ sngags kyi yig 'bru 'khyar ba spang*// zhes gsungs pas so// de ltar bzlas pa'i skabs thams cad du 'od zer spro bsdu sogs kyi dmigs pa la gcun dgos te/

nā ro ta pas/ bsam pa med par sngags bzlas spang*// zhes gsungs so// lha'i dmigs pa yang yang du gsal gdab dgos te/ nā ro ta pas/ lha mi gsal bar sngags bzlas spang*// zhes gsungs so// de'ang lha'i dmigs pa'am/ 'od zer spro bsdu'am tha na sngags kyi sgra lhang lhang ba de dang shes pa 'dres ci thub la 'bad pa gal che zhing*/ de ltar ma yin pa'i tha mal pa'i rnam rtog dang bsres pa'i ngang du yun ring po'i bar du byas kyang nus pa shin tu chung ste/ spyod 'jug las/ bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub kun// yun ring dus su spyad pas kyang*// sems gzhan g.yengs pas byas pa ni// de nyid rig pas don med gsungs// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// rgyu mtshan de bas na bsnyen sgrub la 'jug pa'i tshe byings rmugs rnam g.yeng thams cad drag tu bzlog nas ma 'bad na nus pa 'dres 'phrog par bshad de na ro ta pas/ gnyid kyi dbang du gyur pa spang*// zhes gsungs so// sngags la sogs pa gsang zhing shib bur bzla dgos te/ rtsa ltung bdun pa'i nyes pa 'ong ba'i phyir/ nā ro ta pas/ gsal zhing sngags sgra che ba spang*// zhes gsungs so// de lta bu'i spyod pas tho rangs dang*/ snga dro dang*/ phyi dro dang*/ srod kyi thun dang bzhi'i rim pas 'jug cing*/ de yang dang po skyabs 'gro nas rjes bsngo ba smon lam gyi bar la tha mal gyi long gtam dang mi sre bar smra bcad kyi ngang nas bya dgos shing gzhan du na bsnyen pa'i don med de/ nā ro ta pas/ nus pa myur du bskyed 'dod na// smra ba bcad na dngos grub 'phel// lo gcig sil bu'i bzlas pa bas// zla gcig smra bcad bya ba gces// zhes gsungs so// de ltar byed pa'i gnas kyang ri khrod dben par byas na legs par gsungs te/ nā ro ta pas/ yul dgon lo gcig byas pa bas// ri khrod zhag gcig bsnyen pa gces// zhes gsungs so// de yang thun skabs ma gtogs 'gro 'dug byed pa sogs mi nyan cing stan gcig gi steng du tshar dgos te/

nā ro ta pas/ sgrub sngags 'khyams shing bzla ba spong*// zhes so// bsnyen pa ma tshar bar la stan yang spo 'jug mi nyan te/ klu sgrub nas brgyud pa'i man ngag las/ mal stan nam mkha'i mthongs su sprugs// de res sgrub pa gar byas bya ba yin// zhes gsungs so// de lta bus gtso bo yab yum la 'bum phrag bzhi re/ 'khor rnams la khri phrag re re bzla dgos shing*/ dmigs bsal can la de las mang ba yang bzla dgos par bshad do// de ltar bzlas pa'i tshe nad pa dang*/ rgan po yin na skabs su ngal gso ba'i bar g.yas g.yon du bag tsam re sngas pa la nyes pa med dam sems/ de ma gtogs pa gong sbyor ba'i skabs kyi lus gnad dang mi 'bral ba dgos te/ nā ro ta pas/ mi mos nyal sngags bzla ba spang*// zhes gsungs pa'o// gong ma de rnams kyi don mdor bsdus nas brjod na/ bsnyen pa gang yin pa ma tshar gyi bar la/ thun la 'jug pa nas mthar bsngo ba'i bar la/ nyal ba dang*/ ldang ba dang*/ bzhad gad dang*/ rtsa chu 'chag pa dang*/ zas za ba dang*/ mal stan spo ba dang*/ sprug pa dang*/ mi dang tshig bsre ba dang*/ sngags kyi sgra rgyun bcad pa dang*/ lha dang sngags 'khor gyi dmigs pa mi byed pa dang*/ 'od zer gyi spro bsdu mi byed pa dang*/ phreng ba mdo 'dzin la thug nas phyir mi ldog par mdo 'dzin 'gom nas 'gro ba rnams spang dgos te/ dpung bzang las yin nam snyam/ sngags rnams bzla ba'i man ngag ni// nyal nas ma yin ldangs nas min// dgod cing ma yin 'chag cing min// za zhing ma yin stan mi sprug /phyi yi rgyud ni sag mi bsre// nang gi rgyud ni sgra mi bcad// gsang ba'i rgyud ni ting nge 'dzin// 'phro 'du bcad par mi bya'o// lag phreng mi 'gom mdo 'dzin rdzogs// zhes gsungs pas so// de yang bsnyen sgrub dus su yin gyi gzhan du na/ nā ro ta pas/ phyag rgya chen po 'dod pa la/ de nyid zhal 'khyams rtag tu 'don// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa rjes la/

thun bzhag ran pa dang*/ pha rgyud ma rgyud so so'i yi ge brgya pa bdun nam lnga bton nas lhag chad kha bskang zhing bsnyen pa bsdu ba ste/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs kyi byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub myur du thob par mdzad du gsol/ ces sogs kyi gang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba drag tu gdab/ de nas bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha gang yin pa dang*/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis da lta'i dus 'di la bcom ldan 'das gang yin pa'i mtshan nas smos pa dang*/ de'i rtsa sngags snying po sogs gang bzlas pa de la grangs ma nor bar byas nas brgya stong sogs 'di tshar ba de sku gsung thugs la 'bul bar bgyi'o// bdag la thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces grangs yi dam la gtad pa gdams pa'i mchog yin te/ 'phral nā ro ta pas/ gyi nus pa 'dod pa la// smra bcad grangs dang bcas pa 'don// zhes gsungs pas so// de nas rten 'brel snying po'i rab gnas byas na byin rlabs mi nyams zhing nus pa che ru 'gro bar bshad pas/ ye dharmā bdun la sogs pa ci nus bgrang*/ de rjes dkyil 'khor bsdus nas gtor ma btang ba'am/ thun bzhi ka la gtor ma 'phrod na rab/ de ma grub kyang srod thun gyi mjug tu gtor ma rgyas par gtong dgos shing gshegs su gsol ba la sogs rang rang gi sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin bya/ rjes bsngo ba smon lam rnam par dag pa gdab cing*/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor la sogs pa sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu'i tshul gyis longs spyad do// lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/

gtor ma gtong ba/ sāts+tsha gdab pa/ mdo 'don pa sogs dge bas dus 'da' bar bya'o// de ltar bsnyen pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs nas sbyin sreg phyogs gcig tu blug pa dang*/ nyin bzhin bsnyen pa byed cing mtshan bzhin de'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg blugs nas bsnyen pa dang mnyam tshar byed pa'i lugs gnyis bshad pas gang bde byas pas 'ong zhing*/ de'i lag len mthong ba brgyud pa bzhin legs par bya dgos te/ gsang rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ sngags ma bzlas 'grub pa med// sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byung*// gsang sngags 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pas// sbyin sreg khri phrag bya bar bshad// ces gsungs so// de lta bu'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas grangs kyi bsnyen pa tshad ldan byas na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu tshegs med par 'grub par gsungs te/ gnas skabs kyi dman pa zhi sogs bzhi/ 'bring grub chen brgyad/ 'bring gi mchog mkha' spyod rig 'dzin/ stong 'khor los sgyur ba rnams kyang bsnyen pa song nas bsgrubs pas 'grub par bshad/ mchog gi dngos grub kyang myur du 'grub par bshad de/ nā ro ta pas/ sgrub pa po yi rnal 'byor pa// nyi shu rtsa gcig 'di ldan na// sgrub pa po yi rnal 'byor pas// tshe gcig mchog dang thun mong 'grub// ces gsungs pas so// rje btsun gong ma rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po nas bskul ba'i phyir bzlas pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i don yang de bzhin yin zhing*/ bskul lugs kyang rtsa sngags kyis sku/ snying pos gsung*/ nye snying gi thugs bskul zhing 'bod par gsungs te/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur las dpe dang bcas pa gsungs pa ni/ dper na skyes bu la la zhig /skad kyi nga ros bos pa na// mdun du nges par 'ong ba bzhin// de bzhin gshegs de de bzhin te// zhes gsungs so// de bas na sems kyi rnam g.yeng spangs nas rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas byas na rgyal ba rnams byon nas rgyud byin gyis rlob pa la the tshom med par shes par bya'o// rgyud sde 'og ma gsum po'i bsnyen pa byed na yang*/

lha'i bskyed chog dang gtsang sbra'i kun spyod la sogs pa mi 'dra ba'i dmigs bsal rnams rang rang gi gzhung ltar byed pa dang*/ gzhan thun gyi go rim dang dmigs pa'i gcun thabs rnams la khyad par med pas de ltar shes par bya'o// bsnyen thabs dngos grub bum bzang 'di/ chos rje ā nan+da bha dra dang*/ rat+na dhā dza/ bla ma'i gsung dang grub thob gzhung*/ /mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur sogs/ /rgyud sde rnam par dag pa yi// lung gis cung zad gsal byas nas// rgyal khams pa yis bsdebs pa la// rang bzo'i nyes pa med par sems// skal bzang thar pa don gnyer ba'i// ring na bzhugs pa'i bla ma pas/ bud+dha rat+na/ /dgos zhes gsung phrin byung mod kyang*// khyab pa 'du byed dbang gyur pas// yun ring ma grub bzod par gsol// ma nor lam mchog bzang po la// dad pa ngo mtshar shin tu che// dka' ba brgyas rnyed dka' ba yi// dal 'byor rin chen thob dus 'dir// snying po longs par ma byas na// phyi nas 'di 'dra 'phrad rnyed dka'// brtson pa chen pos 'bad 'tshal lo// 'di bgyis pa las byung ba yi// dge ba dri med gang thob des// bdag dang ma gyur sems can rnams// deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// rdo rje theg pa'i lam mchog dang*// 'bral med bla mas rjes bzung zhing*// bsnyen bsgrub tshul bzhin byed pa dang*// lam gyi bar chad kun bral nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang de// myur du thob par bya phyir bris// 'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po thogs par gyur cig de ltar spyi'i go don sngon du song nas/ dmigs bsal bla med kyi rgyud sde chen po rnams kyi bsnyen pa gtong thabs gzhan du shes par bya zhing*/ 'dir sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang 'brel ba rnams kyi bsnyen thabs cung zad smros na/ kye rdor lhan skyes la mtshon na mchod gtor spyi ltar/

tho 'dzugs sogs spyi 'gro thams cad gong bzhin/ sgrub thabs dmigs rnam ji bzhin nges pa'i sgo nas bsgoms te bsnyen pa de ba pi tsu la grangs 'dzin/ sngags phreng tshur 'khor zhi ba'i 'od zer spro bsdu'i dmigs pa rnam bshad rnams nas 'byung ba bzhin yang yang gsal gdab/ de kho nas sun na rtsa zhal gyi spyan dbus ma nas bzung ste sku'i cha shas re re bzhin dang*/ rgyan dang phyag mtshan sogs yongs rdzogs gsal ba'i bar du sems 'dzin dang cha 'dra bar gsal 'debs shing bzla/ res 'ga' sngags kyi sgra grags stong la sems gtan cing bzla/ res 'ga' sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi rang ngo skyong zhing bzla/ mdor na sems skad cig kyang ma yengs pa nyid gnad du che/ thun mjug tu sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang*/ drag po'i dmigs par rim bzhin bsgyur te cung zad re bzla ba srol du mchis/ grangs ni 'bru 'bum dang*/ kha skong de'i bcu cha bsag de bzhin du dus 'khor lhan skyes la sngon 'gro gtor ma gong bzhin/ de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas bdag bskyed bsdu ldang gi bar btang nas gtor 'bul dang*/ thun gsum mam bzhir bcad lugs gong bzhin/ bzla bya'i sngags rnam pa mang po yod kyang 'dir gtso bo rnam bcu dbang ldan yin no// de la ngag bzlas dang rdor bzlas gnyis las thog mar rdor bzlas kha shas sngon du btang ste/ snying ga'i sa bon las sngags kyi yig 'bru dbugs 'byung ba dang lhan cig tu sna bug g.yas pa nas tha ma hā yis sna drangs te 'gro ba dang*/ dbugs 'jug pa dang lhan cig sna g.yon nas thog ma oṃ gyis sna drangs nas 'jug cing snying ga'i sa bon la thim/ rlung gnas pa na sa bon la sems gtad/ de lta bus rlung dang sbyar ba ci rigs gis bzla'o// bskyed rim rdor bzlas dngos 'di yin no// grangs la rnam bcu dbang ldan ni brtan g.yo ma lus pa'i srog gcig tu 'dus pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa ba'i sngags te/

yab yum gtso 'khor gyi dbye ba med pa 'di kho nas 'grub pa la kha bshad tsam min pa byin rlabs brgyud par ldan pa'i phyag gzhes yin pas ji tsam mang bzhin bzang mod/ sa ya sngon du 'gro bas bye ba tsam bzla ba phyag len du snang ngo gsungs/ bde mchog lhan skyes la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bzhin dang*/ bgegs rnams sum+bhas bskrad/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur bla re ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur par mos te/ rak+ṣas brtan par bya/ sgrub thabs/ gtor 'bul/ thun bcad lugs sogs gong bzhin/ bzlas dmigs ni lnga ste/ 'gro ba dag pa dang*/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ 'gog pa'i bzlas pa/ khro bo'i bzlas pa/ 'do li'i bzlas pa'o// dang po ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis sa gsum po'i 'gro ba lhar byas nas 'od slar hūm̐ la bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa rdor bzlas ni/ hūm̐ las sngags phreng rtsol ba'i rlung hūm̐ dang 'grogs te rang gi sna g.yas nas thon/ 'gro ba lhar byas pa'i sna g.yon nas srog gi rlung oṃ dang 'grogs nas thugs kar slebs te gnas pa ni gnas pa āḥ de ma thag tu de dag gi sna g.yas nas rtsol ba'i rlung hūm̐ dang lhan cig tu thon/ slar rang gi srog gi rlung oṃ dang 'grogs nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim ste gnas pa ni āḥzhes bzla ba'o// gsum pa 'gog bzlas ni/ rnam rtog bkag la yid kyis bzla ba'o// bzhi pa khro bzlas ni/ snod ma yin pa'i skye bo med pa'i sa dang*/ bying ba gseng ba dang*/ gdon gyi bar chad bzlog pa'i phyir 'brug sgra lta bur bzla ba'o// lnga pa 'do li ste khyogs bzlas ni/ yab kyi zhal nas sngags phreng thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs te sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ pad+ma'i lam nas rdo rje lam du zhugs pa sogs 'khor ba'i dmigs pa bya ba'o// de ltar bshad pa rnams gang bzlas kyang skye bo yod pa'i sa ni shib bur bzla'o// de rnams kyang skabs thob dang bstun nas nyams su blang bar bya zhing*/

'on kyang rgyun gyi nyams len la do li'i bzlas pa nyid gtso bor bya ba ste/ rje btsun sku mched dang 'phags pa sogs kyis do li'i bzlas pa kho na las ma bshad pa'i phyir ro// bzlas pa'i grangs ni/ snying po'am nye snying 'bru 'bum las mi nyung bar bzla dgos so// des ma rgyud lhan skyes thams cad la rigs 'gre'o// 'jigs byed dpa' gcig la/ mchod gtor spyi ltar/ sngon 'gro gtor ma hrīḥṣ+ṭ+wiḥs bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥnas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis spyi ltar bsngos nas phrin las bcol ba dang*/ srung 'khor bsgom pa gong bzhin/ sgrub thabs gtong lugs dang thun bcad tshul sogs 'dra/ bzlas dmigs thugs kar nyi gdan la sa bon gyi mthar bzla bya'i sngags bkod nas/ las bzhi'i dmigs pa gang dgos bya/ bzlas grangs 'bru 'bum/ gzhan 'dra/ des gshed rigs kun na 'gre/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa lhan skyes la/ sngon gtor kha bsgyur phran bu las 'jigs byed bzhin/ thun bcad tshul sogs kyang gong bzhin/ bsnyen pa gtso bor rdor bzlas kho na rgyud dang rgya gzhung rnams su che thang du gsungs pa ltar nan tan tu bya zhing*/ ngag bzlas kyi ting nge 'dzin gtso bo spro bsdu la bya/ khyogs bzlas/ khros pa'i bzlas pa/ khro bzlas rnams kyang res mos su bya ste mdo bsre dang mdor byas kyi dgongs par bzhed/ rgyud 'dir bzla bya'i gtso bo 'bru gsum du gsungs pas mtshan sngags dang sa bon gyi kha bsgyur phran bu ma gtogs bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka la 'bru gsum kho na'i rnal 'byor du mdzad pa ni khyad chos yin la/ bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ste don lha thams cad kyi de kho na nyid kyi snying por gsungs pas skabs 'dir de gtso bor bzla/ bzlas grangs ni bye chung tsam grub na legs/ de ltar bsnyen pa gang yin grub pa dang bsnyen pa'i kha skong sbyin sreg ni bsnyen pa'i grangs kyi bcu cha til sngags su phul nas gtang rag gsol skong byas la tho byang yang bsdu/

dam tshig gtsang ba'i nang mi re re tsam dang gdong sprad cing mtshams har 'don mi bya bar zhag shas gnas srung la dal bar bsdad pa'i skabs su rdzogs rim ci nus su bsgoms la rim par glod cing grol/ bsnyen pa song ba'i lha de'i mngon rtogs rgyas bsdus gang rung bzlas pa brgya rtsa sogs gang 'grub re'ang de nas brtsams te nam yang mi chag par rgyun khyer bya/ rang gis shin tu mos pa'i yi dam lta bu la bsnyen pa lan gcig song bas chog par mi brtsi bar bskyar te bsgrubs nas ji ltar bskyar ba de tsam gyis 'grub thag ji nyer 'gyur zhing lan bdun bskyar na skal ba dang mi ldan pas kyang 'grub par bshad do// dmigs bsal gser chos dmar po skor gsum gyi bsnyen pa bya tshul la/ gnas khang sa rgyan gnam rgyan yol ba dang bcas pa dang*/ rang nyid stan gos zhwa thams cad dmar po bya ba gsum char la 'dra zhing*/ khyad par rigs byed ma'i skabs rgyud las/ mya ngan med pa'i tshes la mya ngan med pa'i 'og tu gos dmar po bgos la myos byed kyi 'bras bu za zhing*/ ka ka ma tsi ka'i khu bas theg le byas te sngags khri bzlas so// zhes gsungs pa ltar dus kyang yar ngo'i tshes brgyad kho nar tshugs pa dang*/ rgya gar du shing mya ngan med pa'i 'og tu sgrub pa byed par bshad kyang*/ bod du de mi 'byor bas shing lo gnam rgyan la sbyar ba'am/ de ma 'byor na mya ngan med pa'i shing gnam rgyan la bri bar bdag gi bla ma bzhed cing*/ rgyal dbang mchog gi man ngag gsal byed du'ang gsungs/ myos byed kyi 'bras bu ni po son cha'i 'bru yin pas/ kho rang ngo bo khar bcug na skyugs sman yin gshis de srin bal gyis dril ba bu ram ma bsgar bas dril nas lce 'og tu 'jug pa yin/ ka ka ma

rgya skyegs kyi khu ba yin/ tsi ka'i khu bas mkhur tshos la thig le byas/ pad+ma'i 'dug stangs zhes pa rkang pa'i mthil sbyar nas sdod/ rten ni rje btsun ma'i sku bris 'bur gyi mdun du gtor ma man ngag ltar bsham/ sngags kyi grangs 'bum phrag brgyad dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba drug gsungs kyang mtshan ma gtso che bas ngag shes ltar bya/ kha skong dbang gi sbyin sreg tshar chen rin po che'i yi ge ltar bya'o// tshogs bdag mdun bskyed kho nar brten dgos gshis/ mdun du bris sku tshad ldan gyi mdun du stegs bu gtor ma mchod pa sogs dang*/ bla rdo man ngag ltar bsham/ dmar po skor gsum char kha lta phyogs nub kho nar bya dgos stabs/ rten gtor rnams kha shar du lta dgos shing*/ sngon du gong gnon 'byung 'dul gyi hūm̐ bzhi pa 'bum bzhi song nas tshogs bdag mdun bskyed ltar sgrub pa dang*/ mjug sbyin sreg sogs kho bos zur du bris pa ltar byas pas don 'grub/ 'dod rgyal la/ mdun du rten gtor man ngag ltar bsham/ 'khor lo tshul bzhin bris pa gtor ma'i rgyab dang*/ tha can 'khor lo bzlas pa'i bar rkang pa'i mtheb chen 'og tu mnan rgyu sogs sta gon bya zhing*/ bsnyen pa'i grangs ni thun re rer bzhi brgya rer byas pa'i thun gsum bzhi gang bde zhag nyer gcig gis chog par gsungs shing*/ 'di rnams snyan brgyud kho na yin gshis zhib par rgyun ldan bla ma'i zhal las shes pa kho na'o// gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs la bsnyen pa'i grangs dang*/ mchod gtor bsham lugs sogs so so'i lugs ltar dgos pa gzhir bzhag la spyi'i khog 'bubs tshul gong du rgyas par bshad pa ltar byas pas don 'grub bo// yang dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i sngon du nor rgyun ma'i gong gnon dang*/ dbyangs can sā la'i pho nyar bsnyen sgrub sbags par zhag bdun gyis chog cing*/ gser chos dpal mo gser gyi snying thag can la sgrol dkar gyi gong bsnyen sngon du 'gro dgos pas sogs sgos chos shin tu mang ngo*//

༈ /gur mgon gyi bsnyen pa la sgrub lugs du ma yod kyang*/ 'di bka' sdod lcam dral du sgrub lugs yin/ 'dir bdag bskyed brag rdzong ma'i srung 'khor sogs byas nas bsgrub par snang yang*/ de bar chad che bas bdag bskyed yi dam la brten nas bka' sdod ltar sgrub pa 'di byin rlabs che zhing bar chad mi 'byung*/ 'di la sbyor ba gnas khang dben par yi dam chos skyong sogs dkon mchog gi rten shar ram lhor phyogs pa'i mdun du mchod pa dang*/ khyad par gri thod dam rin po che'i snod gas chag med par/ gtor ma rgyu gtsang ma phud ma nyams pa lhag ma ma 'dres pa la bdud rtsi ril bu/ sman drug rin po che sna lnga sogs bsre/ khu ba mar gsar pa lhad med kyis sbrus/ spyir gtor ma la rten gtor lhar bskyed pa/ gta' gtor byin gyis brlab pa/ rgyun gtor thun du 'bul ba sogs gong ma'i gsung rab na gsal bar bzhugs shing*/ bla ma mnyes pa'i gsung las shes dgos/ 'dir bsnyen pa tsam la gtor ma chos skyong la re re bsham/ kha gso ba ma gtogs yang yang mi bsgul/ dar nag gi gur phub la rdul mi 'chor bar bya/ kha gso ba'i theb kyu'ang gsar pa byung na rab/ ma thub na grib skam byas pas kyang rung ngo*// thun gyi dus su gu gul/ btsan dug sha chen/ yungs kar/ sgog skya chig skyes rnams bsres pa'i bdug spos bsreg bsnyen dus sbyang ba gsar pa mi 'jug mi gsar pa dang mi 'phrad/ gtam gsar pa mi nyan/ thun mtshams su'ang ngag bcad byung na legs/ shin tu gsang nas byed pa gnad yin/ ḍa dril sogs mi bya'o// dngos gzhi ni/ bdag bskyed lam dus thun bzhir bya/ dgong thun la yi dam nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi bar gtor chog ltar bya/ thun gzhan gsum la gtor ma byin rlabs rgyas pa dang*/ spro zhing nus na yi dam dang*/ mgon po lcam dral gyi gtor bsngo gnyis ka bya/ mi nus na lcam dral gyi gtor bsngo rkyang pa byed/

thun bzhi char gyi bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi mgon po lcam dral la phog thugs rgyud bskul zhing zhi rgyas la sogs pa'i phrin las gang bcol sgrub par bsams la/ rang yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pas/ thog mar de ba pi tsu brgya rtsa gcig gis gnya' mnan/ de nas bzla bya'i sngags ni yi ge bcu gnyis ma dang yi ge bdun ma gang rung yin mod/ phyag len gtso bor yi ge bdun ma mdzad pas/ thun gyi dngos gzhi yi ge bdun ma khri tsam sogs gang 'gro dang*/ mjug tu lha gsum lha brgyad gang yin pa'i 'khor sngags kyang phyed phyed phri ba'i cung zad bzla/ grangs ni/ legs grub kyi rgyud las/ yi ge bco lnga man chad la// mkhas pas yi ge 'bum gyi grangs// yi ge sum cu so gnyis la// 'bum phrag bzhi yi grangs kyis so// de las lhag pa'i yi ge la// 'bum phrag gcig gi grangs kyis so// zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs na yi ge bco lnga man chad la spyir 'bru 'bum mdzad kyang*/ 'dir rgyas par ni rje btsun chen pos 'grel pa gur rgyan du bzhed pa 'bru re la 'bum phrag brgyad brgyad de lnga bcu rtsa drug gam/ yang na/ rdzogs ldan dus su gcig bzlas pas// rtsod ldan dus su bzhi 'gyur bzla// zhes gsungs pas bdun bzhi nyi shu rtsa brgyad dam/ da lta dkyus ma ni 'bum phrag bcu drug gis grangs bsnyen rdzogs par bzhed/ 'on kyang 'di la ni mtshan ma kho na las grangs mi gtso gsungs so// lha mo'i ro ru 'bum phrag bzhi/ gzhan rnams la de'i phyed phyed bzla'o// mtshan ma ni/ nag po chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs mthong ba sogs te rgyas par brag rdzong ma'i khrid yig las shes par bya'o// ༈ /zhal bzhi pa'i bsnyen pa byed pa'i tshul la/ 'di'i skabs su thun mong ma yin pa'i tshe sgrub med na/

'khor gdug pa can rnams kyis tshe srog la bar chad 'byung ba dang*/ nor sgrub kyi man ngag med na 'khor dang nor sogs la god kha 'byung ba dang*/ 'gab 'dre mnan pa'i gdams ngag med na/ glo bur gyi 'jigs skrag dang mthong snang gis bar chad du 'gro la/ de dag gi gnyen por man ngag dgos pas mtshams byed pa'i thog mar 'gab 'dre mnan pa'i lag len ni/ gzhi shog bu la ma hā ba la zhes pa ni/ lus dud ka mgo bo gsum brtsegs pa'i 'og ma glang gi mgo dmar po/ bar ma la mi mgo dmar po sbrul za ba/ steng ma mi mgo sngon po mig dar sngon po bcings pa/ lag pas shing gi phur bu 'dzin pa/ lte ba zur gsum du gnas pa'i nang du 'byung po thams cad bkug nas gsod par byed pa/ mjug ma sbrul du yod pa/ de'i rgyab tu/ oṃ shag ma ran/ pra ma sha dun hūm̐ hūm̐ nan dul dul rbad sod/ snying la ma ra ya sod/ ces nor bu lugs su brtsegs mar bris/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas nub ba lang spyod nas ma hā ba la/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs nas/ de la ye dharmā brjod cing me tog gtor nas rab gnas bya/ gtor chung cig oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis bsngo/ de nas 'gong po'i gzugs la gnod byed kyi gzugs bstim/ yi dam lha'i nga rgyal gyis/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa sogs nas/ chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ zhal bzhi pa'i bsnyen sgrub byed pa la rjes su 'brang zhing 'khu zhing zlog pa dang*/ sgrub pa po'i 'khor g.yog sogs la gnod par byed pa'i bdud la sogs pa rnams rten 'di nyid la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yang yang brjod/ sgrub khang gi phyi them gyi 'og tu sa brus pa'i nang du 'gong po'i gzugs gan rkyal du byas pa'i mgo phyir bstan la bzhag

de'i steng du ma hā ba la kha phub la mnan/ de'i steng du ro g.yam kha la ro sol gyis rdo rje rgya gram bris pas mnan/ de'i dpe'u ris zur na yod pas nges par mdzod/ bzlas pa mi dgos/ btsan thabs su mnan pa'i man ngag yin pas de bzhin du bya'o// gnas khang du yi dam chos skyong gi bris sku sogs bkram pa'i mdun du gtor ma lnga tshar/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang*/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod rdo dril sogs bsham mo// bdag bskyed gsang ba 'dus pa'am/ yang na kye rdor lam dus thun bzhi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar byas la/ thun mgo dgong thun nas 'dzin pas gtor ma rnams bdud rtsi chu chang gis bran la/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi sogs nas kun 'grub shog gi bar dkyus bzhin byas la/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phog pas/ de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul zhing zhi rgyas dbang drag la sogs pa'i phrin las rnams bsgrub par bsams la/ lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pas/ thog mar de ba pi tsu brgya rtsa sogs dang*/ mgon po'i sngags gsum dang*/ lha mo'i ro ru rnams gang mang dang*/ de nas zhal bzhi pa la dmigs pa'i sngags gtso bor bzla zhing*/ rjes su sngags ring brgya rtsa sogs ci nus bzla/ de nas las mgon la mo'i bod pa dang pho'i bod pa bzla/ bzlas pa rdzogs nas/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya ar+ghaṃ sogs nas sangs rgyas myur thob shog gi bar dang*/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ mgon po'i bris sku sogs kyi rten yod na/ phyogs bcu na sogs nas/ badz+rā ya swā hā zhes brjod cing rten la me tog gtor/

rten med pa rnams la oṃ khyed kyis sogs bya'o// 'di'i bar la thun mtshams sogs su ngag bcad dang*/ spyad pa gsar pa sogs nang du mi gzhug dril bu sogs mi dkrol bar shin tu gsang bar byed pa mtshams shin tu dam par bya zhing sku rim sogs la brtson par mdzad pa gal che zhing*/ gong du yi dam mgon po'i bsnyen pa sogs phul du phyin pa dgos/ bla ma'i gdams ngag med par rang dga' u tshugs gyi 'dod pa chen pos gnas gar thod thod du 'di'i bsnyen pa sogs la brtson pa ni/ gnam lcags kyi spu gri rnon po la sbar 'dzin byed pa dang 'dra ste/ khe med pa'i steng du nyen chen po bskyed pa ste/ na tsha smyo 'bogs sogs kyis tshe srog dang dngos grub la sogs pa la bar chad byas nas 'di phyi'i sdug bsngal bskyed pas so// yang gtor ma'i rgyu gtsang ma la bdud rtsi ril bu bsres/ gtor ma kha gsos ma gtogs yang yang mi bsgul/ bzlas pa'i dus su sha chen/ mi tshil/ mi dang rta khrag gu gul dkar nag tsan+dan/ yungs kar/ bdud rtsi ril bu/ ga bur/ gur gum/ sran nag dri mi zhim pa'i me tog lha la phul pa'i me tog rnying pa/ mi rus/ sgog skya/ rak+ta/ btsan dug rnams sbyar/ gtor ma'i dus/ bsgrub pa'i dus/ rgyun gyi dus/ mgon po yin nam min brtag pa'i dus bsregs pas gdon yin na 'bros/ mgon po yin na thugs dam la 'byon pas skra gzings pa dang skyi bung byed pa dang lus sbrid pa la sogs pa'i rtags 'byung ngo*// mchod pa'i spos la/ btsan dug rak+ta/ sgog skya chig skyes/ yungs kar/ sran nag a mṛ ta/ khrag tshil chen rnams sbyar nas bzlas pa'i dus su bsreg go /yang srod tho rangs snga thun gsum la yi dam dang zhal gyi gtor ma kha gso/ bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa byas/ gtor ma nang mchod sogs kyis bran/ bsang sbyang sogs nas kun 'grub shog /ces dang oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin rlabs dran par byas nas/

mdun du pam̐ las pad+ma sogs nas 'grub par mdzod ces brjod pa'i mthar bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gong bzhin du/ de ba pi tsu brgya rtsa sogs kyis gnya' mnan/ zhal gyi sngags thung gang 'gro dang*/ mjug tu sngags ring nyung mtha' yang nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzla/ oṃ ma hā kā la sogs nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la nas/ yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol gyis nang mchod phul/ gang gi mthu stobs sogs kyis bstod/ rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis sogs dang yi ge brgya pas kha bskang*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med pa rnams la ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ bsrung ba sogs bya'o// de nas bsnyen pa gang la skyel ba'i sngags nyid gtso bor bzla/ de'ang sngags ring dang sngags thung gnyis char la ma song yang rung bas sngags thung 'bum phrag bzhi la kha skong dang bcas pa bzla'o// mtshams grol ba'i tshe gtor ma gsar pa bshams nas/ bskang gso dang bshags pa dang dga' ston rgya chen po bya'o// 'dir mtshon pa tsam smros kyi gzhan chos skyong gur zhal phyag bzhi drug rnam sras sogs bka' gnyan zhing snyan brgyud kyi zhal shes kho nar ma brten par bab bcol du spyod par ma gnang gshis so so'i yi ge brgyud pa'i gsung sgros yod nges kyi bla ma bsten na sgro 'dogs chod par 'gyur gyi dpe nyog mang po bsdus pa'i bshad yams dang*/ zer sgros la snying po ci yang med do// smras pa/ deng dus mkhas blun khyad par mi phyed cing*// phrag dog dug chus myos pa mang dag gis// legs par bshad kyang nyes par go bas na// 'di 'dra'i dus su 'di 'dras ci zhig bgyi// 'on te gus ldan bzhed pa skong ba dang*// bdag dang bdag 'dra'i blo dman 'ga' zhig la// phan par srid snyam lhag bsam rnam dag gis// bkod la nyes na mkhas rnams bzod par mdzod// legs tshogs dge ba gang zhig mchis pa des// ma gyur mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa'i// ma rig stug po'i mun pa kun bsal nas// kun mkhyen ye shes rgya mtshor 'jug par shog

/ces yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bsnyen pa bya tshul gcig shes kun grol 'di yang*/ thog mar rgyal khab chen po nas gong zhabs mchog gi zhabs 'bring pa gangs can mkhan zur rin po che ngag dbang rab brtan lags kyis 'di lta bu zhig gyis zhes bka' gnang ba dang*/ lcags zam nas gzim dpon rin po che ngag dbang bsod nams kyis bka' gnang ltar ris med kyi grub mtha' la blo gros dkar ba shākya'i btsun pa lhun grub kyis drin can bla ma'i gsung rgyun nyams med dang*/ rgyud sde so so'i dgongs pa zhib tu dpyad de nyams len mdzad pa rnams la phan phyir rgyal zla'i dmar phyogs dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes la dben gnas rmor dgon par bris pa'i yi ge pa ni lho brag shing dgon pa bka' bcu kun bsam gyis bgyis pa 'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che ris su ma chad pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig de ltar rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i rgyud sde bzhi'i bsnyen thabs gcig shes kun grol 'dir kun mkhyen pa'i gsung*/ bla med kyi yi dam 'ga' zhig dang*/ chos skyong gur zhal gyi bsnyen thabs bcas blo gter gyis zhal bsabs pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
